query: How will we validate realism of semi-synthetic/k-space motion: which objective metrics, reader Turing tests, and classifier indistinguishability tests will be required and how will results inform augmentation schedules?

response.query: How will we validate realism of semi-synthetic/k-space motion: which objective metrics, reader Turing tests, and classifier indistinguishability tests will be required and how will results inform augmentation schedules?
response.answer: To validate realism of semi-synthetic/k-space motion, use objective metrics like structural similarity index and classifier indistinguishability tests. Turing tests with human evaluators will also be essential. Results inform augmentation schedules based on perceived realism and accuracy.
